loop.top3_why_not: Candidate A uses only five models; although its per‑window scores are slightly better in the first two windows, it performs noticeably worse in the third, indicating that it may be missing useful information from the other four models. Candidate B (trimmed‑mean pool3) removes 20 % of the models, which could discard valuable signal from the best‑ranked models and introduces additional variance in weight estimation due to the small number of validation windows. Thus, while A and B are reasonable, C offers the best balance of stability, coverage, and performance for this series.
